decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won the DLG/Brotinstitut gold medal again in 2023 and 2024, so its results exceed the aspiration level and give no trigger for problemistic search.
The dark barley malt rye bread survived the 2024 pruning of the rye range and is still shown on its own page, which suggests results acceptable enough to keep it while slack allows carrying it.

The marzipan stollen is a seasonal product that fits the firm's established stollen line, which has a strong reputation, and it is still shown on its own page, so management is likely to continue carrying it.
